bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
query="SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND token_hash IS NOT NULL AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND ((chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1605) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=4))"
n="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'exec psql -X -q -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}" -d "${POSTGRES_DB:-postgres}" -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$1"' sh "$query")" || exit 71
test "$(printf '%s' "$n" | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "2" || exit 72
echo "TWO_TOPIC_PIN_LEDGER_AFTER_REFRESH=PASS"
